snippet.title: Blast Horizon — Launch Trailer | Now on Steam!
snippet.description:
The Screen Belongs to your Enemy - Take it Back!

In this classic Shoot em up, you will fight through impossible odds against hostiles flooding the battlefield from every direction. 

Every second is a test of positioning and precision while turning the battlefield into a storm of explosions.

Available now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4925610?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=trailer&utm_medium=web
